description: HR-96 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Tauru sub-division in Haryana's Nuh district. This office handles vehicle registrations, the issuance of driving licenses, and other transport-related permits for the local sub-divisional area. It was established as part of the newer series of RTO codes to improve administrative efficiency in smaller sub-districts.
address: SDM Office, Tauru, District Nuh, Haryana
